metric_policy: Preserve image lineage/registration; apply explicit reviewed optical similarities against the text grid separately. New Greek needs anatomy landmarks, compiled grid audit and real point-size proofs. Guides are removable, never traced.
north_star: A consistent, thematically unified Baskerville math package with core LaTeX, amsmath and AMS symbol coverage, using the accepted image-derived design.
invariant: Every design starts from one unified design image; every production view and enlargement derives from its approved version.

accepted_seed.scope: 32 Greek and variant targets; accepted visual direction, not complete mathematical coverage.
accepted_seed.weight_status: Italic design accepted; prompted regular weight, visual weight heavy/unresolved pending matched-size proof.

family_master.note: Coordinator accepted source geometry for bounded pilot under user autonomous authorization; weight/font metrics remain provisional, not user approval of unseen results or complete repertoire.

prohibited: Prior enlargement as sole design reference
Silent master or accepted evidence replacement
Silent width warping to hide inconsistency
Claiming current SVGs are a completed font
guidelines_policy: Deterministic thin removable overlay + mask + measured coordinates; always preserve clean original for tracing.

pending_expansion.status: semantic review; invalid cells quarantined; no wholesale promotion
pending_expansion.geometry_rule: Arrow family components are authored consistently against valid root prototype, not independently generated per symbol.
